preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes N must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of main roads M must be between 0 and 120,000.
Each road must connect two valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.
The starting node S must be a valid node within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must contain N-1 space-separated integers representing the shortest distances.
All distances in the output must be non-negative integers.
The distances must be in ascending order based on vertex number.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10."},{"id":"P2","expression":"2 <= N <= 200000","description":"The number of nodes N must be between 2 and 200,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"0 <= M <= 120000","description":"The number of main roads M must be between 0 and 120,000."},{"id":"P4","expression":"1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N","description":"Each road must connect two valid nodes within the range of 1 to N."},{"id":"P5","expression":"1 <= S <= N","description":"The starting node S must be a valid node within the range of 1 to N."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout.split()) == N - 1","description":"The output must contain N-1 space-separated integers representing the shortest distances."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(int(d) >= 0 for d in stdout.split())","description":"All distances in the output must be non-negative integers."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"sorted(map(int, stdout.split())) == list(range(1, N))","description":"The distances must be in ascending order based on vertex number."}],"invariants":[]}
